name: Ba Be food guide
summary: Eat on the stilt-house floor at Pac Ngoi, or at Bo Lu when Long Tong is on. Grilled lake fish, sour shrimp, and five-colour sticky rice are the plates most often named. The Thái Nguyên portal adds grilled shrimp, pork over the fire, and khau nhuc. A current price is Check on arrival. VnExpress printed a few 2014 figures, and those stay with the date.
body: The meal is the Tay table, not a cafe street. VOV, on Vietnam Tourism's rural desk, lists grilled lake fish, sour shrimp, măng vầu, upland sticky rice, and roast suckling pig at Pac Ngoi, with leaf-yeast wine when then singing is on. VnExpress says the hamlet has few shops, so book the meal and carry water.

The Thái Nguyên portal, on 1 April 2026, calls the grilled fish cá mương, clamps it in bamboo, and grills shrimp beside it. It seasons pork over the fire with salt, wine, and ginger, and calls the color golden. VnExpress, on 2 December 2014, describes about 15 minutes on charcoal and calls the smoke yellow-black. The handbook updated 4 February 2025 says the fish is cleaned, seasoned, and better hot, and does not print the 2014 price. Both accounts stay. A current price is Check on arrival.

Five-colour sticky rice is the festival rice. VietnamPlus puts it on the 2026 Long Tong trays at Bo Lu, with glutinous wine. It is the plate with a photograph. That photograph is the dish in Sơn La. The plants that dye it are Check on arrival.

Vietnam Tourism's rural desk says the district built two counters, one in Chợ Rã and one in Nam Mẫu, for OCOP gifts: fragrant green squash, squash tea, dried buffalo, dong vermicelli, jiaogulan tea, dried banana, kitchen-hung sausage, khẩu mẩy vùng cao, Na Hai spring wine, and Nếp Tài rice. Khẩu mẩy is only a name. What it is is Check on arrival. The counter hour is Check on arrival.
specialtiesLead: Five-colour sticky rice is the plate with a photograph. The other specialties follow, each with the publisher that named it.

sections.heading: The stilt-house table
paragraphs: These are the plates and greens a publisher names at the house. Khẩu mẩy vùng cao is a name on the district gift list. What it is is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled lake fish
spots.note: Small cá mương, clamped in bamboo and grilled. VOV lists it first. VnExpress printed 10,000 VND for 3 skewers on 2 December 2014. A current price is Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled lake shrimp
spots.note: The Thái Nguyên portal grills the shrimp with the fish until both are golden. A price is Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Sour shrimp
spots.note: Jarred lake shrimp, mildly sour, with boiled trotter or belly, sour starfruit, green banana, and đinh lăng. VnExpress printed 50,000–70,000 VND a box on 2 December 2014. A current price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Soured lake shrimp
spots.address: The boat landing, and Pác Ngòi
spots.note: Tép soured with nương rice and leaf yeast. VnExpress printed 40,000 VND a jar on 28 November 2014. A current price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Mang vau
spots.note: The bamboo shoot on VOV's house list. How it is cooked is Check on arrival. Other publishers' forest bamboo is a separate row.

spots.name: Forest bamboo
spots.note: The provincial portal stir-fries, boils, soups, or dries it. The ethnic desk names the boiled shoot. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Upland sticky rice
spots.note: Steamed in a wooden pot. VnExpress eats it with grilled fish, pork over the fire, or thịt rim, and does not describe thịt rim. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Roast suckling pig
spots.note: On VOV's house list. Book it with the meal. A weight and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bamboo-tube rice
spots.note: Grilled in the tube. The provincial portal eats it with sesame salt. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Pork over the fire
spots.note: Salt, wine, and ginger on the portal. Yellow-black from the smoke, and a year's keep, on VnExpress in 2014. Both stay. For guests and for Tết. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Kitchen-hung sausage
spots.address: The house, and the OCOP counters
spots.note: Village pork with gừng đá in the VnExpress handbook, then smoked or hung. The rural desk lists it as a gift. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Khau nhuc
spots.address: The house, for a festival, Tết, or a wedding
spots.note: Belly and taro, fried, layered, and steamed. The Thái Nguyên portal. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Crisp stream fish
spots.address: A house meal at the park
spots.note: Small stream fish, fried crisp, or grilled, or simmered with sour bamboo. Vietnam Tourism's rural desk, 29 September 2025. With lá lốt and chili fish sauce, or bamboo-tube rice. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Hill chicken
spots.note: VnExpress lists it for a stay in the village. How it is cooked is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Boiled chicken
spots.note: On the 2026 offering trays with five-colour sticky rice and glutinous wine. VietnamPlus. A boiling time is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Fiddlehead fern
spots.note: Stir-fried, boiled, or as nộm, the day it is picked. VnExpress, 2 December 2014. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Forest sweet leaf
spots.note: Sweet and fragrant, on the Thái Nguyên portal. How it is cooked is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Trotter
spots.note: Boiled, beside sour shrimp, in VnExpress. Braised, chân giò hầm, on the ethnic desk. Both stay. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Buffalo with sour bamboo
spots.nameVi: Thịt trâu gác bếp xào măng chua
spots.note: Named by Vietnam Tourism's ethnic desk as Tay food of the lake. A pan time is Check on arrival. Dried buffalo is a separate gift.

sections.heading: Cakes
paragraphs: The mugwort cake is the one the provincial portal describes. VOV's 2019 market names bánh dày gấc and bánh gai. VietnamPlus lists a bánh dày contest at the 2026 Long Tong and does not say which cake is in the contest.

spots.name: Mugwort rice cake
spots.note: Upland sticky rice pounded with mugwort, filled with sesame or beans. The Thái Nguyên portal. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Gac rice cake
spots.note: VOV lists it at the 2019 weekend market. A filling beyond the name is Check on arrival. Whether that market still opens is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh gai
spots.note: VOV lists it at the 2019 market and does not say what is in the cake. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Tay rice cake
spots.note: A round cake, crisp shell, white dusting, moderately sweet. The provincial portal. The rural desk writes bánh trôi for the cake made with the village. A price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Drinks
paragraphs: Four names, and no publisher says they are one bottle. Leaf-yeast wine is the evening cup. Glutinous wine is on the offering tray. Corn wine is the cup with sour shrimp. Na Hai spring wine is the gift at the counter.

spots.name: Leaf-yeast wine
spots.note: The cup with then singing. VOV. Whether it is the festival wine, the corn wine, or the Na Hai gift is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Glutinous wine
spots.note: On the 2026 offering trays with five-colour sticky rice. VietnamPlus. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Corn wine
spots.note: A small hot cup with sour shrimp. VnExpress, 2 December 2014. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Na Hai spring wine
spots.note: An OCOP gift. The rural desk does not say it is the leaf-yeast cup. A price is Check on arrival. The counter hour is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Gifts at the counters
paragraphs: Vietnam Tourism's rural desk lists these as gifts at the counters in Chợ Rã and Nam Mẫu. Kitchen-hung sausage is on that list and on the house table. Khẩu mẩy vùng cao is the name the list does not define.

spots.name: Dong vermicelli
spots.note: An OCOP gift. How it is served is Check on arrival. The counter hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Fragrant green squash
spots.note: An OCOP gourd. A recipe was not printed. The counter hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Green-squash tea
spots.note: The tea from that gourd. A brew is Check on arrival. The counter hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Dried buffalo
spots.note: An OCOP gift. Not the smoked-buffalo stir-fry, and not the pork over the fire. How it is eaten is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Jiaogulan tea
spots.note: An OCOP tea. A brew is Check on arrival. The counter hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Dried banana
spots.note: An OCOP gift. Not the seeded banana on the path to Ao Tien. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Seeded banana
spots.address: The path to Ao Tiên, and from the gate down to the lake
spots.note: VnExpress printed about 20,000–25,000 VND a hand on 2 December 2014. A current price is Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Nep Tai rice
spots.note: An OCOP rice. Whether the upland sticky-rice bowl is this variety is Check on arrival. The counter hour is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Casual dining
paragraphs: There is no cafe street. You eat in the house, you buy gifts at the two counters, and VOV once reported a weekend market at Pac Ngoi.

spots.name: Pac Ngoi kitchens
spots.nameVi: Bữa ăn nhà sàn Pác Ngòi
spots.note: The stilt-house meal. VOV's list is grilled fish, sour shrimp, măng vầu, upland sticky rice, and roast suckling pig, with leaf-yeast wine. VnExpress says the hamlet has few shops, so book the meal and carry water. A public lunch hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: OCOP counters
spots.address: Thị trấn Chợ Rã, and xã Nam Mẫu
spots.note: Two counters for OCOP gifts and local specialties. Vietnam Tourism's rural desk. The hour is Check on arrival. The place names on the rural desk are the ones printed before the provincial merger.

spots.name: Pac Ngoi night market
spots.note: VOV, on 25 September 2019, reported a first weekend night market over the 2 September holiday, with bamboo-tube rice, grilled fish, five-colour sticky rice, bánh gai, and bánh dày gấc. The culture director said it would repeat on weekends. Whether it still opens is Check on arrival.

seoTitle: Ba Be food guide — the Tay table on the lake
seoDescription: Grilled lake fish, sour shrimp, five-colour sticky rice, and the gifts at Cho Ra. A current price is Check on arrival. The 2014 figures stay with their date.
